paper_title: PELMS Pre-training for Effective Low-Shot Multi-Document Summarization
caption: Low-shot pre-trained model performance on the multi-document summarization (MDS) task with ROUGE-G scores (geometric mean of ROUGE-1/2/L) aggregated over 6 MDS benchmarks. We compare with fully-supervised training (solid lines) and with adapter training (dashed lines) where only 5% of model parameters are tuned. achieves stronger overall performance at all data quantities and training methods when compared to competitive long-input summarization models.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the ROUGE-G score, aggregated as a percentage, for various models trained using different methodologies across a range of training examples. The x-axis represents the number of training examples, ranging from 0 to 64, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 16. The y-axis represents the ROUGE-G score, displayed on a logarithmic scale with values ranging from approximately 10 to 19.0, and is marked with tick labels at intervals of 5. The first line, identified as “PELMS,” is a solid green line starting around 11.5 and ending around 17.0. The second line, “PELMS (5%)”, is a dashed green line beginning at approximately 11.0 and culminating at a value of approximately 17.5. The third line, “Primera,” a solid orange line, starts at approximately 12.0 and reaches a value of approximately 18.0. The fourth line, “Primera (5%)”, a dashed orange line, commences at approximately 11.5 and ends at approximately 17.5. The fifth line, “Pegasus-X,” is a dashed teal line beginning at approximately 10.0 and stabilizing at approximately 16.0. The sixth line, “Centrum,” is a solid yellow line that begins at approximately 11.0 and ends at approximately 17.0.
